# Vendored QR Code generator (BrightScript)

Source: [paramount-engineering/QR-Code-generator-brightscript](https://github.com/paramount-engineering/QR-Code-generator-brightscript)
License: MIT (see `LICENSE.txt`)

Derivative of [Project Nayuki QR Code generator](https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library) (MIT).

Prairie changes:

- Component renamed to `PrairieQrCode`
- Empty `text` clears the Poster URI instead of encoding
- Removed unused `binary` field and debug print
